_comment: classifieds authorization. A public catalog: anyone (role 'anon') may browse (list/get) the taxonomy, geo, and listings; posting/editing needs a logged-in 'user'; the catalog (category/category_attribute/geo) is admin-curated. Roles are matched exactly (no wildcard), so read actions list both 'anon' and 'user' (admin is a superuser and bypasses). listing_facet is an internal derived index — no direct client access (queries read it server-side). self_register is on for early testing; gate it for production.
_comment_chat: Chat: conversations are created via the start_conversation rpc (raw inserts, bypass policy), so create/update/delete here are admin-only; list/get scope to the user's own conversations via owner_any. conversation_member is the internal VIA membership table (admin only; the engine reads it via raw SQL). message: create is allowed for users but before() enforces conversation membership (VIA can't gate inserts); list/get use owner_via so /api reads AND realtime subscribe are scoped to the caller's conversations; messages are immutable (no update/delete).
_comment_rpc: NOTE: the engine does not currently enforce this _rpc whitelist (rpc has no authorization layer) — it documents intent, and sensitive rpcs self-guard in hooks.lua (rebuild_facets checks role=admin). search/category_form/listing are intentionally public.
